preconditions.description: The desired length n and the given string length m satisfy 1 <= m <= n <= 100000.
The difference between n and m is at most 2000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == m and all(c in '()' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s has length m and consists only of '(' and ')' characters.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of pairs (p, q) such that p + s + q is a valid bracket sequence of length n, modulo 10^9 + 7. A sequence is valid if total '(' equals total ')' and every prefix has count('(') >= count(')'). The count includes all valid p and q strings of appropriate lengths summing to n - m.
